definitions.explanation: Being or living outside one's own country. Used as a prefix-like element in official compounds about citizens, offices and assets located abroad.

examples.japanese: {在外|ざいがい}⟦{邦人|ほうじん}→邦人：32020_houjin⟧
{在外|ざいがい}⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I completed the procedure for overseas voting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{在外|ざいがい}⟦{邦人|ほうじん}→邦人：32020_houjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: When a conflict breaks out, the government first checks on the safety of its nationals abroad.

notes:
An official, written word, common in news and government notices; in conversation people say ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在外|ざいがい}⟦{邦人|ほうじん}→邦人：32020_houjin⟧: Japanese nationals abroad
- {在外|ざいがい}⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧: overseas voting
- {在外|ざいがい}{公館|こうかん}: diplomatic missions abroad (embassies and consulates)
- {在外|ざいがい}⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧: overseas assets
